experiences.description: Support day-to-day infrastructure for a growing services company, handling user accounts, backups, and routine server maintenance. I monitor system health, document recurring fixes into runbooks, and escalate the trickier incidents with clear context. This is my first full-time role and where I am building hands-on operations habits.

projects.title: Resort Operations Server Backbone
projects.summary: Set up and maintained the on-premise servers for a hospitality IT solution serving several resort properties. I configured services for reliability, scripted routine maintenance, and kept the booking backend available during peak periods. The hardening work reduced unplanned downtime across the pilot sites.

projects.title: Campus Secure Access Initiative
projects.summary: Administered systems and access controls for a platform shared by schools and law offices, with a strong focus on data protection. I tightened authentication policies, segmented sensitive data stores, and ran regular integrity checks. The improvements closed several gaps flagged in an internal review.

projects.title: DevPortal Hosting Environment
projects.summary: Maintained the hosting environment for an internal developer portal used by a software team and a property group. I managed the database layer and web services, automating restarts and routine health checks. My monitoring setup caught capacity issues before they reached users.
